modulePatterns.src/lib/ui-provider/messages/*: Message dictionaries and their types: text assets with no visual surface and no Figma node; the provider they feed is recorded separately
modulePatterns.src/components/primitives/*: shadcn/Base UI primitives exported for composition; Figma mapping attaches to the composed family components, not to the primitives
modulePatterns.src/components/icons/*: icon and pictogram runtime plus generated name lists, covered by the • Icon and • Pictograms bulk rules
modulePatterns.pagopa-ui-artwork*: the generated artwork package: the icon and pictogram name lists and the variant types are covered by the • Icon and • Pictograms bulk rules

exports.ErrorSummary: Form-level error announcement: the single live region of the field family's error strategy (flusso D). It lists the caller-owned messages with links back to their controls; no independent Figma source node, retained as a deliberate accessibility extension, not a source-alignment claim.
exports.DatePickerField: The custom date chooser: a labelled trigger that opens the source DatePicker panel (8049:39452) and carries the native field contract (local ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` value, named form control, reset and required validation). No independent 1:1 source node; retained as the documented field composition around the source calendar, not a source-alignment claim.
exports.SafeArea: Responsive maximum-width and gutter composition helper used inside PageSurface. No independent 1:1 source node; not a source-aligned component claim.
exports.UIProvider: Library context provider that configures application integration (the link component every navigation link renders through). It paints nothing and has no independent 1:1 source node; not a source-aligned component claim.
exports.DownloadCard: Production native download-link/action composition with installed-consumer keyboard evidence. No independent 1:1 source node; retained as a deliberate accessibility-oriented extension, not a source-alignment claim.
exports.OrganizationModule: Read-only organization summary with caller-owned optional content, no inferred payment-system membership and rendered public evidence. Deliberate composition extension without a dedicated source node; not a source-alignment claim.
exports.SwitchGroup: Caller-owned SwitchField collection with native fieldset/legend semantics and an associated description. Deliberate collection extension, not the similarly named Figma component set at 349:4683: that source is one rich choice and is mapped to SwitchField.
exports.CheckboxGroup: Caller-owned CheckboxField collection with native fieldset/legend semantics and group messages. Deliberate collection extension, not the rich single option at node 194:3763, which is mapped to CheckboxField.
exports.TableHeaderField: The Figma helper `.TableHeaderSingleItem` (1337:73971) was removed from the design file in the 2026-10-14 export. The implementation keeps the reviewed 48px header cell with [12,16] padding, grey-100 fill and label metrics; retained as a reviewed extension without a dedicated source node.
exports.TableListField: The Figma helper `.TableListItemField` (9520:2555) was removed from the design file in the 2026-10-14 export. The implementation keeps the reviewed 14/20 grey-700 label and the 4px mobile gap; retained as a reviewed extension without a dedicated source node.
